_comment: CANONICAL heartbeat-ack wire fixture. Committed in vizora-tv and asserted against
in BOTH repos, because the ack crosses a process boundary that nothing else checks.
The envelope is exactly what the server's createSuccessResponse() emits
(Vizora realtime/src/gateways/dto/index.ts) — { success, data, timestamp } — and the
client unwraps `.data` by hand (vizora-tv src/main.ts). Neither side imports the
other, so until now a change on either side could silently stop the other working.
That is not hypothetical. `reconcileContent` was wired on both sides, unit-tested
green on both, and was ALWAYS undefined at runtime until the ack-.data unwrap was
fixed (Vizora tasks/pending-decisions.md:379-403). Two more instances followed in the
same subsystem: an unwhitelisted heartbeat field rejected every beat for four
releases, and a mistyped impression timestamp rejected every impression for the
repo's lifetime. All three were client->server or server->client shape mismatches
that each side's own tests could not see.
If you change this file, the corresponding test fails in BOTH repos — which is the
point. Change it only when the wire format genuinely changes, and change both sides.
